description: This Java source file defines the REST API resource for self-managed client operations in the Fineract platform, including listing, retrieving, and managing client images, charges, transactions, and related details.

classes.name: SelfClientsApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for managing self clients, including listing, retrieving, and managing images, charges, and transactions.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Lists clients associated with the authenticated user, supporting pagination and filtering.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific client by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAssociatedAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves account overview for a specific client.

methods.name: retrieveImage
methods.description: Retrieves the image associated with a client.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientCharges
methods.description: Lists charges for a specific client with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveClientCharge
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific charge for a client.

methods.name: retrieveAllClientTransactions
methods.description: Lists transactions for a client with pagination.

methods.name: retrieveClientTransaction
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific transaction for a client.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Adds a new image for a client, supporting multipart form data.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Adds a new image for a client via JSON or text body.

methods.name: deleteClientImage
methods.description: Deletes the image associated with a client.

methods.name: retrieveObligeeDetails
methods.description: Retrieves obligee details for a client.

methods.name: validateAppuserClientsMapping
methods.description: Validates that the current user is mapped to the specified client.
